prompt: My daughter has a blue passport and my son has a blue passport and I have a piece of paper that has been expiring and being renewed and expiring again for fifteen years. Last month the letter came that the other letters were warning me about. My daughter cried and said this is not fair and she is right that it is not fair and I did not know what else to say to her.
